dropped.evidence: When you visit our sites, our computers may automatically collect statistics about your visit. This information does not identify you personally, but rather about your visit to our sites. We may monitor statistics such as how many people visit our sites, the user's IP address, which pages people visit on our sites, from which domains our visitors reach our sites, and which browsers people use. We use these statistics about your visit for aggregation purposes only. These statistics are used to help us improve the performance of our Web sites.
dropped.rationale: The policy discloses that it collects IP addresses and device IDs for statistical purposes, but does not specify a purpose.
